specs.Antenna Location: YouTube vlogging, travel vlogging, underwater activities, sports events

features: 【4K ULTRA HD VIDEO ACTION CAMERA】: Record your travel, biking, sports and outdoor adventures in stunning 4K at 30FPS. The camera also supports 2.7K, 1080P and 720P video resolutions, giving you flexibility to choose the right quality for every recording

【170° WIDE-ANGLE LENS】: Capture more of the scene in every frame with the 170° wide-angle lens. Perfect for action shots, scenic landscapes, bike rides, travel videos and group moments, providing a broader and more immersive perspective

【BUILT-IN WIFI CONNECTIVITY】: Connect the camera to your compatible smartphone through WiFi for convenient wireless control and file management. Preview your footage, operate the camera remotely and transfer photos or videos for quick sharing

【30M WATERPROOF HOUSING】: Take your camera on underwater adventures with the included waterproof housing, designed for use up to 30 metres underwater. Ideal for swimming, snorkelling, water sports, rainy conditions and outdoor exploration

【MULTIPLE SHOOTING MODES & MOUNTING ACCESSORIES】: Explore different creative shooting options with versatile photo and video modes. The included mounting accessories make it convenient to attach the camera to compatible helmets, bicycles and motorcycles for hands-free recording
